seoTitle: West Ada School District Calendar: Key Dates & Official PDFs
seoDescription: Reviewed West Ada School District dates, official calendar PDFs, K-8 conference closures, preschool Fridays, secondary A/B schedules, and senior dates.
districtFact: West Ada is Idaho's largest school district, serving approximately 40,000 students across 59 schools. Its calendar reaches beyond one generic K-12 list: preschool has no Friday classes, middle and high schools publish separate A/B rotations, and some conference and preparation days apply only to grades K-8.

about.title: The District Calendar Changes by Grade Band
about.content: West Ada's student calendar distinguishes K-8 closures from high-school attendance. On the fall conference date, grades K-8 do not attend while grades 9-12 remain in session and hold evening conferences. K-8 also receives a separate September teacher-preparation day in the verified future calendars.

about.title: Preschool Has a Four-Day Week
about.content: The official 2026-27 ECSE Preschool Calendar states that preschool does not meet on Fridays. Preschool follows many district breaks and staff days, but its last day is May 19, one day before the K-12 calendar ends.

about.title: Middle and High Schools Use Separate A/B Files
about.content: West Ada publishes one A/B rotation for high schools and another for middle schools. The files map every instructional date to an A or B day and show different regular and Wednesday first-bell times, so the district date list alone cannot answer which classes meet.

about.title: A Fast-Growing Treasure Valley District
about.content: The district traces its start to a 1950 consolidation of all or part of 33 smaller districts around Meridian, Eagle, and Star. Renamed West Ada in 2014, it now serves communities including Boise, Eagle, Garden City, Kuna, Meridian, and Star.

about.title: Seniors Finish Before the Districtwide Last Day
about.content: Each reviewed student calendar gives seniors an earlier final day. In 2026-27, the district also publishes a graduation-week high-school schedule that moves advisory to the end of the day while keeping the school day's opening and closing times unchanged.

calendarNotes: The main dates on this site follow West Ada's K-12 Student Calendar. For 2026-27, preschool families should use the ECSE calendar, and middle- or high-school students should pair district dates with the correct A/B rotation. The official page adds operational details not printed on the main PDF, including the August 12 first-day late start and the high-school graduation-week bell schedule.

planningTips.title: West Ada Calendar Planning Notes
content: Check the student's grade before treating a date as no school: the September preparation day and fall daytime conference closure apply to K-8, while grades 9-12 remain in session on the conference date.
Use the separate high-school or middle-school A/B calendar to determine which class block meets; the district student calendar does not print daily A/B letters.
For ECSE preschool, remember that there is no preschool on Fridays and that the preschool last day can differ from K-12.
The first day in 2026-27 is a late-start day according to West Ada's live calendar page, even though the one-page PDF labels it only as the first day of school.
Keep the reason for April's no-school date year-specific: the 2027-28 PDF calls April 14 a Working Calendar Adjustment, while the two earlier PDFs do not state a reason.
Seniors finish before other students; high-school families should also check graduation-week bell-schedule notices.

livingHere.intro: West Ada grew from rural school districts west of Boise into Idaho's largest public school system, following the rapid expansion of the Treasure Valley.

districtFaqs.q: Do all West Ada students use the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: They share the main K-12 dates, but preschool has a separate calendar and middle and high schools use separate A/B rotation files. Some no-school dates also apply only to grades K-8.

districtFaqs.q: Do West Ada high school students attend on the K-8 conference day?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. In the verified future calendars, grades K-8 have no school on the daytime fall conference date, while grades 9-12 remain in session and hold evening parent-teacher conferences.

districtFaqs.q: Does West Ada preschool meet on Fridays?
districtFaqs.a: No. The official 2026-27 ECSE Preschool Calendar explicitly says there is no preschool on Fridays.

districtFaqs.q: What are West Ada A and B days?
districtFaqs.a: The secondary A/B calendars assign alternating class blocks to instructional dates. High-school A days use periods 1A-4A and B days use periods 1B-4B; middle schools publish their own rotation and bell-time legend.

districtFaqs.q: Why is the senior last day earlier?
districtFaqs.a: West Ada prints a separate senior final day before the districtwide last day. Graduation-week high-school scheduling may also move advisory so ceremonies can begin earlier without shortening the overall school day.

customSections.label: Why It Is Called West Ada
customSections.content: The district began in 1950 after Idaho school consolidation brought together all or part of 33 smaller districts around Meridian, Eagle, and Star. Long called the Meridian School District informally, it adopted the West Ada name in 2014 to reflect a service area that also reaches Boise, Garden City, Kuna, and Star.

customSections.content: The district's live calendar page combines the current date list with downloadable K-12, preschool, and secondary A/B files. Recheck it for revised PDFs and graduation-week notices.
